methodology.limitation: Recent public London records with commercial-class rows, not a random sample of our eligible developments. No independent application-form verification yet. Selection fixed before human labels.

review.method: Frozen predictions compared manually against all 40 descriptions and internal row consistency. Contradicted means inconsistent with stated application scope, not a verified replacement value. Unverified never counts as correct. No field has independent numerical verification in this first pass. Additional public-source checks saved separately.

labels.reason: The description gives extensions without the affected uses. The commercial row could describe retained ground-floor space; none of its measurements is independently verified.

labels.reason: The proposal adds a Class C3 dwelling, but the adapter publishes 64 m² of commercial gain and a proposed E(c)(ii) use. The description-to-class parser did not protect this case.
